changes.before: The United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement proposed the extension of Canada's copyright term to life plus 70 years, while performances and sound recordings will be protected for 75 years. It has been signed and ratified. [citation]  This agreement replaces the North American Free Trade Agreement. [citation]  In its May 2019 report, the Standing Committee on Canadian Heritage has recommended that the extension be implemented. [citation]  The bill introduced to implement the USMCA did not include the extension language. This was reportedly done to allow a transition period to determine the best way to meet the extension obligation. [citation]  A commitment to the obligation was included in the 2022 Canadian federal budget. [citation]
